summary: Layer 1B expands the public-stock universe around solid-rocket-motor inputs and adjacent energetics bottlenecks. The strongest underfollowed public candidate from available evidence is NewMarket, because its AMPAC acquisition gives it direct exposure to ammonium perchlorate, a suspected chokepoint chemical for U.S. missile and rocket-motor production. Karman is a second underfollowed candidate through solid-rocket-motor nozzles, shrouds, and propellant-driven actuators rather than raw energetic chemicals. L3Harris and Northrop Grumman are included only as reference anchors because they are large, visible solid-rocket-motor producers and likely customers/integrators whose capacity expansion may reveal where sub-tier bottlenecks sit.
